Details: Colour of light emitted: Red to SAE document J578c, February, 1977 "Color Specification for Electric Signal Lighting Devices", or as specified in clause 60.3.2.
Intensity of light emitted

Minimum: In each direction corresponding to the points in the light distribution table of clause 60.3.1, the luminous intensity must be not less than the figure specified in the table for the direction in question.

Maximum: 160 cd in any direction. The luminous intensity must not exceed this maximum over an area larger than that generated by a 0.25o radius within a solid cone angle from 10L to 10R and from 10U to 5D.
Minimum angles of light distribution referred to the reference axis
Vertical: from 10o above to 5o below the horizontal.
Horizontal: from 10o to the left to 10o to the right.
Other Requirements Each lamp must:-
have an effective projected luminous area not less than 29 square centimetres;
not contain symbols, letters or characters other than those necessary for part number, manufacturer’s identification and/or approval number identification;
provide access for convenient replacement of the globe without the use of special tools;
provide a steady warning light;

except as provided in clauses 60.2.1 to 60.2.4.2, be designed to conform to the relevant requirements of clauses 1 to 3 of SAE document J186a, September, 1977 "Supplemental High Mounted Stop and Rear Turn Signal Lamps", except that:
Table 1 of that SAE document is replaced by the light distribution table of clause 60.3.1;
lamps designed solely for mounting inside the vehicle need not meet the requirements of paragraphs 3.1.6 Moisture Test; 3.1.7 Dust Test; and 3.1.8 Corrosion Test of that SAE document.
Colour of light trichromatic co-ordinates
Red: limit towards yellow: y < 0.335 limit towards purple: z < 0.008

For verifying the limits above, a source of light at a colour temperature of 2856K (illuminant A of the International Commission of Illumination (CIE)), in combination with appropriate filters, may be used.
Presence Mandatory.
Number One.
Arrangement No special requirement.
Position
In width: on the vehicle’s median longitudinal plane.
In height: at any position including on the glazing, except that no portion of the lens must be lower than the bottom edge of the rear window by more than:
152 mm for convertibles;
77 mm for other vehicles.
Geometric visibility
The reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle must be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road and lie in the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
Vertical: from 10o above to 5o below the horizontal.
Horizontal: from 10o to the left to 10o to the right.
Orientation Rearwards.
May not be "grouped" with any other lamp.

Req Name: No Combining with Other Lamps or Reflectors
Details: May not be "combined" with any other lamp or reflective device.
May not be "reciprocally incorporated" with any other lamp.
Electrical Operation shall be activated upon and only upon application of the service brakes.
Tell-tale Optional.

Other requirements If the lamp is mounted inside the vehicle, it must be shrouded to the glass or other means must be provided to minimise reflections from the light of the lamp upon the rear window glazing that might be visible to the driver when viewed directly, or indirectly, in the rear vision mirror.
